title: Survivor's Notes
author: Whoever had this room before you
pages: Water first. Water from rivers and ponds is dirty: cook the bottle in a furnace or over a campfire before you drink. Torches burn out. Lanterns built with scrap electronics last.

Noise and light bring them. Running, doors, digging and every shot carry. A lit room at night draws them from the street unless the windows are hung with wool, carpet or banners. The siren means a horde tonight.

A bite can turn into fever: weak after twelve minutes, very sick at twenty, dead eight minutes after that. A bandage holds it still for a minute. Antibiotics push it back a stage, or cure it if you catch it early.

Build a Bunker Core: scrap metal, iron blocks and an Energy Cell. It claims your home, and a Field Charger only works inside a claim. Use the radio for the grid report, hold it to a relay for its log, and press G for the map.
